evals.name: impact-filter-dto
evals.prompt: SearchInvoiceFilter의 프로퍼티 타입을 바꾸면 영향받는 ViewModel·서비스·메서드를 전부 리스트업해줘. 레이어별로 묶어서 보여주고, 어디부터 깨질지 감을 잡고 싶어.
assertions: Uses neo4j Cypher (USES_TYPE/USES) to find references to SearchInvoiceFilter rather than only grepping source
Groups results by layer (ViewModel / Service / Repository / Controller)
Returns concrete method or class fullNames, not vague prose
Notes at least one blind spot or caveat (e.g. transitive impact, or file:line not in graph)

evals.name: e2e-search-order
evals.prompt: SearchOrderView의 SearchCommand(검색 버튼)를 누르면 어떤 핸들러 → IOrderService → 어떤 엔티티까지 흐르는지 E2E 체인을 추적해서 Mermaid graph TD로 그려줘.
assertions: Produces a Mermaid graph TD diagram of the chain
Chain includes ViewModel/Command → handler → Vanuatu.Service interface method → Torba server impl → entity
Correctly resolves the handler (SearchOrderAsync) and service call (SearchOrdersAsync) from the graph
Reaches at least one concrete entity (e.g. Order)
Crosses the interface→impl boundary via IMPLEMENTS_METHOD filtered to Torba (does not stop at the interface)

evals.name: module-inventory-order
evals.prompt: Shefa.Module.Order 모듈에 속한 View·ViewModel·Command를 전부 나열하고, View ↔ ViewModel BINDS_TO 매칭을 표로 보여줘. 그리고 대응되는 View가 없는 고아 ViewModel도 찾아줘.
assertions: Scopes the module via fullName STARTS WITH 'Shefa.Module.Order' (no Project→Class edge assumed)
Lists Views, ViewModels, and Commands as inventory
Provides a View ↔ ViewModel BINDS_TO match table
Identifies orphan ViewModels (no inbound BINDS_TO)
Distinguishes or notes *VMFilter as intentional view-less filter holders

evals.name: boundary-impl-entities
evals.prompt: IOrderService의 주문 검색 메서드(SearchOrders 계열)를 구현한 서버 측 메서드를 찾고, 그 서버 메서드가 실제로 만지는 엔티티까지 보여줘.
assertions: Traverses IMPLEMENTS_METHOD in the correct direction (impl → interface) and filters impl to Torba.* for the server side
Returns the server implementation fullName (Torba.Service.Order.OrderService.SearchOrdersAsync)
Lists concrete entities the server method touches
Notes the interface is also implemented by the Shefa client and that it filtered to the server

evals.name: di-lifetime-services
evals.prompt: IPaymentService·IOrderService·ICustomerService의 DI 등록 생명주기를 보여줘. Scoped/Singleton/Transient 중 무엇으로 등록됐나?
assertions: Uses the REGISTERS relationship and its lifetime property
Returns a lifetime for each of the three interfaces
Surfaces that some interfaces are registered with more than one lifetime (Singleton AND Scoped) rather than reporting just one
Explains the multi-registration honestly (multiple startups / no context property on REGISTERS)
